game_concept: A action defense set in The Kingdom – Library Tower, the royal library tower: the town guard must handle rogue knights while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Score Keeper: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while rogue knights close in.
theme: The Kingdom – Library Tower: the royal library tower
core_gameplay_loop: In Library Tower, repeat each round: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while rogue knights close in. Each round, rogue knights strike the town gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the score value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the town gate from rogue knights in Library Tower: keep the score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Score Keeper
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Score Keeper' (Week 1 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Library Tower'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue knights in Library Tower.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while score > 0.
